name: ContractsInTransitFundingTracker
tagline: From signature to funded – every dealer finance contract, stipulation and lender in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete dealer F&I funding app for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: submit contract packages to lenders, request and clear stipulations, move deals through funding review and approval, handle kick-backs with reason codes and resubmission, record funding with a variance check, and track days in transit, aged CIT, dealer reserve, carry cost and lender scorecards.
features: Lender submission with contract number and expected funding
Funding review / approval blocked by open stips
Kick-back reason codes, resubmission and recontract
Days in transit aging with target and warning days
Lender funding SLA in working days and kick-back rate
Dealer reserve (actual or estimated) and rate markup cap
Daily carry cost of unfunded contracts
